Iris Park: Heads-up from a support case: onboarding sample app produced duplicate shipments. Root-cause looks like token refresh overlap + immediate retry on 429.

Liam O'Connor: which SDK/version?

Iris Park: js-sdk v1.5.2 sample-app v0.7. App sets Idempotency-Key but header is stripped by the auth replay path when refresh happens.

Zoe Martinez: we've fixed header-preserve in other SDKs but customers still hit races. Two things we should do: (A) ensure auth replay preserves user headers by default, and (B) add a small client-side replay detection window so SDKs can dedupe immediate replays even without an Idempotency-Key.

Liam O'Connor: Agreed. For (B) propose a 15s replay window keyed by method+path+body hash. If Idempotency-Key exists prefer server-side dedupe. Also add an opt-in strictRetries flag (default=false) that refuses to retry non-idempotent methods without Idempotency-Key.

Iris Park: backoff policy suggestion: full jitter per attempt: sleep = rand(0, min(maxBackoff, base * 2^attempt)). base=250ms, maxBackoff=4s. Keeps bursts down.

Zoe Martinez: add telemetry events: sdk.replay.header_preserved, sdk.replay.dedup_local, sdk.replay.strict_blocked. QA: unit test simulating token refresh + 429 asserting single backend create, and an integration parity test across node/go/python sample apps.

Liam O'Connor: will prepare a small PR to whitelist Idempotency-Key in the auth replay code and implement the local replay cache with a configurable window. I'll include docs snippet and the telemetry hooks.

ops-bot: Created ticket DEX-4777: "js-sdk: preserve user headers during auth replay + local replay window" https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-4777

Iris Park: also check streaming/resume paths; same replay code is reused there. If necessary open follow-up for stream parity.

devex-bot: Noted. Follow-up DEX-4778 for streaming.
